```python
rgb = bot.rgbd('left')['rgb']
yy, xx = np.indices(rgb.shape[:2])
measurements = {}
for label, vertices in {
    'purple_top': [(298, 158), (329, 140), (346, 168), (314, 186)],
    'orange_top': [(333, 253), (385, 231), (409, 283), (361, 307)],
    'table': [(250, 195), (275, 195), (275, 220), (250, 220)]
}.items():
    mask = np.ones(rgb.shape[:2], dtype=bool)
    for a, b in zip(vertices, vertices[1:] + vertices[:1]):
        mask &= (b[0] - a[0]) * (yy - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (xx - a[0]) >= 0
    measurements[label] = bot.localize_object(label, mask, camera='left', arm='left')['surfaces_in_arm_bases']['left']
print(measurements)
print(bot.status()['tool_geometry_reference'])
```
